artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial = input.initial_value
    local current = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local raw_change = (current - initial) / initial * 100
    local rounded = math.round(raw_change * 100) / 100

    local direction: string
    if rounded > 0 then
        direction = "up"
    elseif rounded < 0 then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = rounded, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percent change from an initial value to current value and indicate direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a rounded percent change and whether the value went up, down, or stayed flat.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- list customers in the segment
    local list_res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if list_res.ok == false then
        return { error = list_res.error, message = list_res.message }
    end

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sends_made: number = 0

    for _, cust in list_res.customers do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            if sends_made >= 10 then
                break
            end
            local text = ("Hi %s, we miss you!"):format(cust.name)
            local send_res = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
            if send_res.ok == false then
                table.insert(failed, cust.id)
            else
                table.insert(notified, cust.id)
            end
            sends_made += 1
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- Validate initial_value
    if input.initial_value == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value may not be zero" }
    end

    local initial: number = input.initial_value
    local current: number = input.current_value

    -- Compute raw percentage change
    local raw: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100

    -- Round to 2 decimal places with correct handling for negatives
    local scaled: number = raw * 100
    local rounded_scaled: number
    if scaled >= 0 then
        rounded_scaled = math.floor(scaled + 0.5)
    else
        rounded_scaled = math.ceil(scaled - 0.5)
    end
    local percentage_change: number = rounded_scaled / 100

    -- Determine direction
    local direction: string
    if percentage_change > 0 then
        direction = "up"
    elseif percentage_change < 0 then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = percentage_change, direction = direction }
end

artifact.name: celsius_to_fahrenheit
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- Ensure celsius is a number; coerce if possible
    local c = input.celsius
    if typeof(c) ~= "number" then
        -- attempt to coerce from string-like input
        if typeof(c) == "string" then
            local n = tonumber(c)
            if n ~= nil then
                c = n
            else
                c = 0.0
            end
        else
            c = 0.0
        end
    end

    local fahrenheit = c * (9.0 / 5.0) + 32.0
    return { fahrenheit = fahrenheit }
end
